**Wire verb `proteins parse-accession`**: Read protein accessions back into their entry, isoform or version, and applied sequence variants, with mzLib's accession grammars, never repairing one that does not fit.

# Wraps

- [`VariantApplication.ParseAccession`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/VariantApplication.cs) in `mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/VariantApplication.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ProteoformAccession`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/ProteoformAccession.cs) in `mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/ProteoformAccession.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ProteinAccession.Parse`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs) in `mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`AccessionNamespace`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs) in `mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accessions` (wire `--accessions`) | `string[]` | required | — | `>= 1 line` | Read from stdin (not an option): one accession per line, given to mzLib exactly as read, with no trimming, case folding or splitting. Blank lines are skipped. One row per line, in input order, duplicates included. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `record_count` | `int` | accessions | never | Rows: the input accessions. |
| `namespace_counts` | `map<string,int>` | accessions | never | Namespace -&gt; accessions in it; all three keys (unrecognized, uniprot, refseq) always present, zeros included. |
| `with_applied_variants_count` | `int` | accessions | never | Accessions that name applied variants (has\_applied\_variants true). |
| `columns` (wire `column_names`) | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns in order. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | Column name to one value per input, in input order. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Seven static caveats. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `string` | — | never | The line exactly as read (ProteoformAccession.Verbatim). |
| `entry_accession` | `string` | — | never | The UniProt entry or unversioned RefSeq accession (ProteinAccession.EntryAccession): P04637 for P04637-2\_S70N, NP\_000537 for NP\_000537.3\_R72P. Equal to input when unrecognized. Names an entry, not a sequence. |
| `isoform` | `int` | — | yes: no UniProt -n isoform suffix (always null for RefSeq and unrecognized), or a number too large for a 32-bit integer | The UniProt isoform number (ProteinAccession.Isoform). |
| `version` | `int` | — | yes: no RefSeq .n version (always null for UniProt and unrecognized), or a number too large for a 32-bit integer | The RefSeq version (ProteinAccession.Version). |
| `namespace` | `string` | — | never | uniprot, refseq or unrecognized: mzLib's AccessionNamespace, lower case as genes resolve and mzLib's GeneResolutionTsv write it. |
| `parent_accession` | `string` | — | never | The accession of the entry the variants were applied to, as written, isoform or version kept (ProteoformAccession.Entry.Verbatim): P04637-2 for P04637-2\_Q5\*. Equal to input when there are no applied variants. |
| `applied_variants` | `string` | — | yes: the accession names no applied variant | The variant suffix as written, without the leading '\_' (ProteoformAccession.AppliedVariants): S70N, or S70N\_A80T for several. |
| `has_applied_variants` | `bool` | — | never | ProteoformAccession.HasAppliedVariants: applied\_variants is not null. |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | no accessions on stdin |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | never expected: ParseAccession does not throw |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | never returned by this verb |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- Parses, never repairs (mzLib's rule): an accession outside the UniProt and RefSeq protein grammars is unrecognized and kept verbatim, entry\_accession equal to input. That includes lower case, surrounding spaces, a FASTA header (sp\|P04637\|P53\_HUMAN), a decoy, contaminant or entrapment prefix (DECOY\_P04637), and ProteinDbLoader's collision counter (P04637\_2, which names a different entry whose accession collided).
- entry\_accession names the entry, not a sequence: P04637 and P04637-2 share it but are different sequences, and the isoform UniProt displays for an entry can carry any number. It answers 'same entry', never 'same sequence'.
- A protein-group accession joined with '\|' (P04637\|P02768) is unrecognized as a whole: mzLib does not split it. Split protein groups first.
- Only RefSeq protein accessions (NP\_, XP\_, YP\_, WP\_, AP\_) are recognized; a RefSeq transcript (NM\_) or an Ensembl id (ENSP...) is unrecognized.
- A variant suffix is read only after an entry mzLib recognizes, in the form mzLib's GetAccession writes: '\_', the original residues, a 1-based position, the variant residues (S70N; a deletion A80; a stop gain Q5\*), repeated for several (S70N\_A80T). applied\_variants is that suffix as written: it is not checked against any sequence.
- An isoform or version number too large for a 32-bit integer (over 2147483647) reads as null while the accession still counts as UniProt or RefSeq: mzLib keeps the entry and drops the number.
- Each stdin line is one accession, given to mzLib exactly as read; blank lines are skipped. One row per line, in input order, duplicates included.
